MACE WIN: In the base text of the FY27 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), we secured a major victory for our servicemembers and military families of South Carolina.

Naval Hospital Beaufort is getting its services back. Inpatient care, operating services, chiropractic care, and emergency room services, fully restored.

The care our servicemembers and their families depend on. People who served this country, sacrificed for this country, and deserve access to real medical care close to hom

MACE WIN: We helped secure $120 MILLION for the Hilton Head Bridge replacement.

South Carolina is growing fast, and our infrastructure must keep pace. This investment will improve safety and strengthen a critical connection for the Lowcountry.

No one works harder to deliver results for South Carolina.

South Carolina STRONG.

Corruption is so deeply rooted in the South Carolina justice system. Child predators like Donald Gresh are being let out of jail after ONE day.

One day when he was facing a 60-year sentence.

This man had over 1,900 images of children. Toddlers as young as three years old being r*ped by animals. And the system cut him loose after a single day behind bars.

This is not a mistake. This is corruption. And it is putting our children at risk.

Every parent in South Carolina should be furious. We are

Corruption and fraud run deep in our government. We are ready for the days of law and order to be restored. We don't care what the crime is, people need to start going to jail again for breaking the law.

Video

MACE WIN: We secured a $161,700,000 authorization for a Nuclear Power Training Facility Simulation Expansion at Joint Base Charleston in the base text of the FY27 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA). 

Joint Base Charleston is one of the most critical military installations in the country. Investing in its nuclear power training capabilities means investing directly in the readiness and strength of our national defense.

South Carolina STRONG.

MACE WIN: In the base text of the FY27 National Defense Authorization Act (NDAA), we secured $81,690,000 and $85,040,000 as extensions of FY23 authorizations for Recruit Barracks at MCRD Parris Island.

The Lowcountry makes Marines and we will make sure it always does. We are committed to getting them what they need to develop recruits into the best of the best.

South Carolina STRONG.

Another one. 

The House Ethics Committee is now investigating Rep. Jimmy Gomez for alleged sexual misconduct. This has become a pattern, and for decades both parties have worked together to protect each other and keep YOU in the dark.

We introduced a resolution in February to expose every single sexual harassment and misconduct record in Congress. Both parties killed it.

So we took it a step further. We moved to subpoena the sexual harassment slush fund records and gave the American people th

Taxpayers deserve to know how their money is being spent.

The federal government spends over $100 billion annually on IT, cybersecurity, and software licenses, yet agencies often don't even know what they've already purchased.

Our SAMOSA Act changes this. Passed by the House back in December, this bill cuts duplicative spending, modernizes federal software purchasing, and ensures taxpayer dollars are spent wisely.

Every dollar the government wastes is a dollar taken from hardworking Americans

Washington has always protected its own. We said enough is enough.

Members of Congress have been using YOUR tax dollars to cover up their own misconduct for years. We moved to subpoena the sexual harassment slush fund records and gave you the names of every Member who used your money to cover it up.

We don't care if there's an R or a D beside your name. If you're abusing your position and spending taxpayer money to hide it, you don't deserve a seat in Congress.

Read our NY Times piece on hold

The girl who walked into The Citadel and refused to quit, no matter what was thrown at her, is still inside of me.

I was the first woman to graduate from one of the most demanding military colleges in the country. They did not make it easy. But I did not leave.

I will not quit. I will not back down. I never have.

Every year, an estimated 250,000 to 320,000 babies are born on U.S. soil to illegal immigrant mothers, each one instantly eligible for a full range of federal benefits. Each one is a potential anchor for parents and extended family members to obtain legal status down the line. 

Reports estimate illegal immigrants and their U.S.-born children impose a net annual cost of $150.6 billion on American taxpayers, a number rising each year.

Our seniors built this country.

We helped deliver No Tax on Social Security in the One Big Beautiful Bill. A $6,000 deduction for seniors, $12,000 for married couples, meaning 88% of Social Security recipients pay zero federal income taxes on those benefits.

We introduced legislation to keep Social Security and Medicare for citizens and legal permanent residents only.

And our office has returned over $1.5 million directly to South Carolina seniors by solving cases with Social Security and Med

We introduced the Preserving Social Security and Medicare for Citizens Act to limit Social Security and Medicare benefits to American citizens, nationals, and lawful permanent residents, while subjecting currently exempt nonimmigrant visa workers to payroll taxes.

These benefits are for Americans who play by the rules, not for foreign nationals or those here illegally. This bill draws a clear line, strengthens these programs, and protects what hardworking Americans have earned.

The Preserving

No one works harder to expose corruption in Congress and bring taxpayers real transparency.

We introduced a resolution to expose Congress's sexual harassment and misconduct records, every single one. The names, the cases, the details they've been burying behind closed doors for years.

Both parties teamed up to kill it. Protecting themselves. Protecting their friends.

We didn't stop there. We moved to subpoena the sexual harassment slush fund records, the ones showing exactly how much of your

Grooming children is not something to celebrate.

Not now, not ever. Protect our kids.

From day one, we have been the biggest champion for the victims of Jeffrey Epstein. We were one of only four Republicans to force the release of the Epstein files. 

We will always stand for justice for those who have been silenced and ignored. They deserve the truth. They deserve accountability.

This isn't political for us, it's personal. Our moral compass will never allow us to look the other way.

Hold the Line.

JUST IN: We're introducing a constitutional amendment tomorrow to slam shut one of the biggest loopholes in American immigration law: automatic citizenship for children born on U.S. soil to parents who are here illegally.

The joint resolution would clarify, under the 14th Amendment, a person born in the United States is only "subject to the jurisdiction" of the United States, and eligible for citizenship, if at least one parent is a U.S. citizen, a U.S. national, or a lawful permanent resident.

When Moncks Corner needed help making its streets safer, we delivered. 

We helped the town secure a $1.2 MILLION federal grant to advance a key infrastructure project designed to improve pedestrian safety, connectivity and access throughout Moncks Corner.

This project will establish a safe mobility corridor linking several neighborhoods to major destinations, including Old Santee Canal Park, Moncks Corner Elementary School, Roper Hospital and local businesses, ensuring residents, students, and

It does not matter who you are or where you come from. If you cannot do the job, you should not have the job.

DEI has no place in the military, the FBI, the Secret Service, law enforcement, or fire departments. Putting DEI over merit will cost people their lives.

Video

Our Skills-Based Federal Contracting Act PASSED the House in February.

The federal government has been requiring college degrees for contractor jobs where a degree has nothing to do with the work. Hardworking Americans with real skills have been locked out. Not because they are unqualified. Because they did not spend four years in a classroom.

Our bill stops federal agencies from slapping unnecessary degree requirements on contractor positions without written justification.
